# Dioptron

> Sovereign web runtime with agent co-tenancy, in Phase 01 implementation.

Dioptron defines a local web substrate where operator and AI agents are peer tenants on one capability surface for browsing, ingesting, querying, and acting on the web. Phase 01 implementation started on 2026-09-25: a Rust workspace under `crates/` holds `syntheke` (capability contract), `epitrope` (authorization), `phylake` (custody store), `dioptron` (daemon), and `xenos` (independent test client), each a skeleton until its implementation slice lands.

## Surface

The current surface is the design corpus (requirements, topology, tenancy, decisions, training-data taxonomy, lexicon, and open questions) plus the Rust workspace skeleton in `crates/`.

## Architecture

Structured LLM corpus:
- [_llm/architecture.toml](_llm/architecture.toml): bands, layers, tenancy plane, and planned implementation surface
- [_llm/current_state.toml](_llm/current_state.toml): phase, recent decisions, and open threads
- [_llm/decisions.toml](_llm/decisions.toml): accepted web-runtime decisions
- [_llm/glossary.toml](_llm/glossary.toml): dioptron vocabulary
